Beyond the tour

The tour is just the start

BeMama is a full companion app. Calls, live sessions, community, and daily tracking are all inside once you sign in.

Voice and video calls

  • Private voice calls
  • Face-to-face video calls
  • Started right from your conversations

Live sessions

  • Live camera sessions inside blog posts
  • Watch or host in real time
  • Chat with viewers while live

Community spaces

  • Groups for every stage
  • Q&A with real parents
  • Saved messages
  • Photo and video sharing in chat

Daily Journey

  • Four journeys: planning, pregnancy, baby, child
  • Fresh guidance every day
  • Daily reminders you control

Tracking and reports

  • Ten care trackers, sleep to growth
  • Cycle calendar
  • Visual history and reports

Support in your language

  • Clearly labeled AI-assisted answers
  • Available in seven languages
  • Private by design
